description: This Java class defines a command to modify a specific property of a feature within a thing in Eclipse Ditto's model. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, validating inputs, and serializing the command, implementing the command pattern for modifying JSON-based feature properties.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureProperty
classes.description: A command class to modify a specific property of a feature attached to a thing, including serialization/deserialization mechanisms and validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create ModifyFeatureProperty from ThingId and other parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to create an instance from a JSON string.

methods.name: getPropertyPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the property to modify.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the new value for the property.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the thing.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the entity payload, which is the property value.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the resource to modify.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command into a JSON object.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the command with updated headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether this command affects authorization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
